lead: `Timers::publish` bumps a deadline equal to its base by a nanosecond, and two adjacent `Instant::now()` calls can be equal.
body: A test that arms at `let start = Instant::now()` on a `Timers` built the line before and sweeps at exactly `start + margin` is a nanosecond short of overdue and reports nothing, only under load. Arm strictly after the base whenever the sweep instant derives from the armed one.
